order: case order in frozen reader, theory-only then library; reverse lanes in repetition 2
certificate_policy: Every reported successful derivation must have every input and local entailment checked, including all formula-to-clause preprocessing. Bundled checkproof does not suffice. Unsupported proof steps mean certificate unknown. Inputs contain only original axioms/target or complete already admitted ground lemma interfaces; never target proof commands.
comparison_limits: External E calculus is not the finite GCTS command/catalog language and has no fixed row boundary; CPU/wall limits differ from GCTS soft wall cutoff. Equal theory/library means semantic inputs only, not matched candidate grammar.
preparation: clone/build separate from prover run costs
validator_predeclared: Independent local entailment refutations: parse every TSTP formula, bind each input exactly to the frozen TPTP mapping, check assume_negation explicitly, normalize each parent conjunction with negated child via polarity-correct NNF and fresh scoped Skolem symbols, generate finitely many universal ground instances, and certify unsatisfiability with exhaustive binary propositional proof trees and equality/congruence conflict leaves. Incomplete instantiation can only yield unknown. Reject opaque preprocessing/introduced symbols that are not accounted for; no skipped proof lines.
gcts_reference: Notebook 68, 70 frozen recipient observations; reused, not rerun with E. Concurrent research workloads and different algorithms/checkers prevent strict speed-ratio attribution.
